entities.summary: Jeffrey Michael Fisher is an American professional football coach, executive, and former cornerback and return specialist. He served as a head coach in the National Football League (NFL) for 22 seasons, primarily with the Houston / Tennessee Oilers / Titans franchise. Fisher coached the Oilers / Titans from 1994 to 2010 and the St. Louis / Los Angeles Rams from 2012 to 2016. He is currently the commissioner of Arena Football One, after serving as interim commissioner of the previous incarnation of the Arena Football League and also majority owner of the AF1's Nashville Kats.
